summary: Plain 2D array with cell/local-space conversion built in. No MonoBehaviour, no world plane.
overview: The data structure under the grid tools: a typed 2D array that knows how to convert between a cell coordinate and a local-space position. Deliberately not a MonoBehaviour and deliberately not tied to a world plane — GridComponent decides whether it maps to XZ or XY, which keeps this reusable for both.
useCases: Grid logic in a plain C# class, testable without a scene.
A second grid of a different type overlaid on the same space, such as a cost field beside a tile map.
Reusing the conversion maths without taking on a component.

gotchas.title: Local space, so world placement is someone else's job
gotchas.body: Positions it returns are local. Anything world-facing has to go through the component that owns it, or through your own transform.
